name: PR Why+Risk Brief: card renders honestly (no LLM in the hermetic stack), Retry keeps the error state, Overview tab still renders
description: Covers what the hermetic e2e stack can actually exercise for the brief (SPEC-03). Unlike onboarding, the brief has NO skeleton/degraded fallback (server/src/modules/brief/service.ts: 'a model failure propagates -> 5xx - NO skeleton/degraded fallback, NO partial persist', AC-16). The hermetic stack sets no OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (scripts/e2e.sh), so container.llm(provider) throws ConfigError (server/src/platform/container.ts buildLlm) BEFORE any model call, mapped to a 500 (ConfigError statusCode=500). useBrief's query therefore lands on isError, and PrBriefCard renders its EmptyState('Brief unavailable', cta 'Retry') branch (PrBriefCard.tsx) - never the success branch with what/why/risk_level/review_focus, and never the success-only 'Regenerate' button. AC-11 (rendered fields) and AC-9 (Regenerate replaces the brief) cannot be exercised end-to-end in this key-less harness; this flow instead asserts the honest error state, that clicking Retry re-fetches and still shows the same honest error (no crash, no stale/blank UI), and that the rest of the Overview tab (Intent, Blast radius - DB-only, no LLM) keeps rendering alongside the failed brief card.
